ñāṇabhūta.p: [Ñāṇa+bhūta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is already intelligent/wisdom, One who has perception/wisdom which should be attained. (2) One who has the nature of wisdom. (3) One who attains the wisdom/perception. (4) It likes the wisdom. (5) One who is attained insight/perception, who attained the special wisdom. (6) One who fear it by wisdom.
